title: Say Melodiya ya Angiyalis ed Palandey
intro: Magano yo lan naamtaan so istorya na sakey a makapadinayew ya lingkor nen Allah. Diad dalin na saray mensahero tan manuley, sayan pigura et abendisyonan na madibinon libro, mabiskeg a boses, tan biskeg nen say bakal. Legan mon babasaen iray pakapatnagan, sarag mon naamtaan no siopa iya?
clues: Sakey ak ya lingkor nen Allah ya inikdan na espisyal a libro.
Marakep so boses ko, tan say panangidayew ko et inad-aro ya anggan saray pukdol tan manok et akiulop ed siak.
Akaarap ak ed sakey a makapataktakot a kalaban ed sakey a bantog a bakal, tan anggaman mas melag ak, analo ak.
Say bakal et ginawan malimpek parad siak, kanian makapanggawa ak na armas panamegley na dilin limak.
Ginawa ak a manoley ed sakey a baleg a bansa, tan bantog so kakabatan ko ed panagsintinsia.
Say anak kon laki, ya sakey met a propeta, et naikdan na kontrol ed dagem tan saray jinn.

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Nagmaliw ya propeta tan ari na Israel
outcome.answer: Nagmaliw ya propeta tan ari na Israel

arabic: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
verse: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allāh] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise. (38:18)
